code-change.after:
# ADR-006: Admin Access Control for Settings and References
## Status Implemented (2025-09-16)
## Context Regular users were able to access administrative functions including reference data management and system settings, creating security risks and potential data integrity issues.
## Decision Implement comprehensive role-based access control:
### Frontend Protection: - Hide navigation elements for non-admin users - Filter settings categories based on admin status - Add client-side route protection
### Backend Protection: - Server-side layout load functions with admin checks - Proper HTTP error responses (401/403) - Session validation for admin routes
### User Experience: - Clear error messages for unauthorized access - Graceful redirects to safe pages - Toast notifications for attempted access
## Implementation
### Navigation Changes: - `Layout.svelte`: Hide "Справочники" menu and Settings icon for non-admins - `SettingsNavigation.svelte`: Filter all categories for non-admin users
### Route Protection: - `+layout.server.ts`: Server-side admin validation - `+layout.svelte`: Client-side admin checks with fallback UI
### Testing: - Comprehensive test coverage for role-based restrictions - Both positive and negative test cases - Component and integration tests
## Consequences
### Positive: - Enhanced security with proper access control - Clear separation between admin and user capabilities - Consistent user experience across the application - Proper error handling and user feedback
### Negative: - Additional complexity in navigation logic - More conditional rendering in components - Increased test coverage requirements
## Rollback Strategy If issues arise, changes can be reverted by: 1. Removing conditional navigation filtering 2. Deleting server-side layout protection 3. Restoring original SettingsNavigation filtering 4. Removing admin-specific UI components
